verdict.rationale: Drata publishes a first-party v2 API reference at developers.drata.com/openapi/reference/v2, organized by resource tag (Controls, Personnel, Policies, Risks, Devices and others) with per-endpoint entries. Nothing in the evidence shows the interactive 'try it' or runnable-example part of the story, and probes for a raw OpenAPI spec at common paths all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser try-it console or runnable request examples, code samples per endpoint, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference's interactivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
